foret.name: La forêt · The forest
foret.alt: A bright, sunny forest glade painted in ink and gouache. Along the back, six painted ways lead deeper into the woods: a wooden arch hung with birdhouses, a little signpost painted with a swan, an arch of pink flowers, a carved arch with paw prints, a signpost painted with a wolf's head, and a giant hollow tree. Left: four smiling manta rays climb up a tree trunk, a squirrel bounces on a branch like a diving board, another squirrel cracks a walnut on a stump, toy racing cars zoom along a track made of twisting roots, and a log burns with little flames as it rests on top of a round bush. Right: a boa coils on a fallen log, a fir tree drips sap into a little pan, a throne is carved from a great tree trunk, a bison calf peeps out of a big round bush, pine cones drop into a frying pan on a stove, and a lumberjack in a checked shirt chops a tree. The white gate at the bottom left leads out to the valley.

arbres.name: Les arbres · The trees
arbres.alt: A grove of great trees. Left half: a hiker admiring a fawn, a squirrel and mushrooms, a shiny tin-foil leaf landing on a blank sheet of paper, and a moose lying happily on a soft bed of moss. Right half: a great tree bending its branches into an arbour over a children's picnic, a mighty oak dropping acorns with a chain swing, a chameleon hidden in the foliage, a mushroom wearing a champion's medal, a palm tree dropping a coconut onto a crab's sunhat, and an ancient olive tree with a sleepy owl in its hollow. In the middle stands an old tree stump covered in tiny things to look at closer. The hollow-tree arch at the top left leads back to the forest glade.

doors.label: La forêt · The forest
doors.hint: Walk back through the hollow-tree arch to the forest

zooms.label: la souche · the stump
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

souche.name: La souche des arbres · The trees' stump
souche.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump in the grove. Left: a lizard sunbathing on a rock fanning itself with a giant palm leaf, a pony nibbling bark off a trunk, a bicycle swallowed by thick vegetation, and ferns, moss and one cheeky mushroom bursting up through a little cabin floor. Centre: a fox in a ranger's hat leading the way along a forest path. Right: an apple tree full of shiny red apples, a shrub clipped into the bust of a Roman emperor, a jazz trumpeter beside a bush of white jasmine, a worm climbing a tall elm, and a squirrel glancing up at a giant acorn.

animaux.name: Les animaux · The animals
animaux.alt: A wild clearing full of animals. Left half: a goat in a hat placing a bet at a little kiosk, a furry little creature giving rangers a tour of its burrow, a monkey swinging on a vine dropping a banana onto a dozing tiger, forest animals queuing at an old phone box, an ostrich rushing for a spilled sack of oats, and a zebra driving a striped van across golden grass while giraffes peer in. Right half: a zookeeper with a hedgehog on his knee while a fox and a badger wait their turn, a monkey singing into a banana microphone, a lion yawning as a butterfly flutters past, a dragon puffing steam beside a toasted acorn, a tiger with an empty teacup, a rabbit in a frying pan munching a carrot, a snake coiled round a pan, and an old tree stump with tiny things to look at closer. The carved arch at the top left leads back to the glade; the paw-print arch at the top right leads to the wolves.

doors.label: La forêt · The forest
doors.hint: Walk back through the carved arch to the forest

doors.label: Les prédateurs · The predators
doors.hint: Walk under the paw-print arch to the predators

zooms.label: la souche · the stump
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

soucheanimaux.name: La souche des animaux · The animals' stump
soucheanimaux.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump among the animals, all on the right: a boy at the zoo squirted by a baby elephant through the bars of its cage, an elephant cooling herself with a huge paper fan, a squirrel scurrying up a sapling with an acorn, a cheeky squirrel jeering at a grey cat, a lizard in a tiny crown on a hot rock, a big cat stretching on a rock, a crocodile in a waistcoat shaking a heron's wing, a hare pulling a lever, a teal reptile in a deckchair, a mother bear cuddling her cub, a stick lodge with a cosy reading nook, and a rat in a top hat making the mice gasp. On the left, the snake's frying pan in the grass.

loups.name: Les prédateurs · The predators
loups.alt: A pine wood where the predators hunt. Left side: a fox chasing its own tail while a beagle sits puzzled, a hawk diving at a toy mouse, a tailor holding up a fur coat for a fox, and a lion showing a claw beside a griffin statue. Right side: a wolf running round a loop, a hunter whose rabbit hops away laughing, a mouse tiptoeing away from a trap under a pie, a moose galloping across a frozen lake, a bear riding a grey horse, and an old tree stump with little scenes to look at closer. The paw-print arch at the top left leads back to the forest.

doors.label: La forêt · The forest
doors.hint: Walk back through the paw-print arch to the forest

zooms.label: la souche · the stump
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

soucheloups.name: La souche des prédateurs · The predators' stump
soucheloups.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump: a boy in striped pyjamas stands on the stump hurling a pillow at a grey wolf howling at the sky, an adventurer in a pith helmet drives a little blue van with a map flapping out of the window, a red fox sprints through a finish-line ribbon, a woodpecker holds a tiny pickaxe on a rock, and a wild boar sings with its mouth wide open as music notes float up. The grey horse's tail swishes at the left edge.

oiseaux.name: Les oiseaux · The birds
oiseaux.alt: A birdsong clearing. Left half: a tiny elf riding a bird's wing, a peacock dropping a feather that a robin uses as a quill, and a hen paddling in a little pool beside her eggs. Right half: a bird singing on a zoo gate, a robin in the grass, a duck dipping its head into a watering can, a wren on a rock in a stream, a tiny hovel where a mouse dances, and an old tree stump with tiny things to look at closer. The birdhouse arch at the top left leads back to the glade; the blue swan arch at the top right leads to the lake.

doors.label: La forêt · The forest
doors.hint: Walk back under the birdhouse arch to the forest

doors.label: Le lac · The lake
doors.hint: Walk under the blue swan arch to the lake

zooms.label: la souche · the stump
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

soucheoiseaux.name: La souche des oiseaux · The birds' stump
soucheoiseaux.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump in the birdsong clearing. Left: a goose bawling "wah wah" with big tears in a pond while a farmer boy reaches out to her. Right: a toucan pecking a fruit with its huge beak, a pigeon strutting in a bow tie, a stag standing to attention and saluting, a nest with three eggs beside a boy's knee, and an eagle guarding an egg on a high rocky nest.

cygnes.name: Le lac · The lake
cygnes.alt: A lakeside clearing in warm evening light. Left side: a flock of swallows holding up a map to plan their migration, and a squirrel holding a big curling fern frond over its head like an umbrella. In the middle, a big birdcage aviary full of finches and parrots with a puzzled pigeon in front. Right side: a white swan gliding up to a little wooden sign on the lake, a fluffy yellow chick pushing to the front of the bird-feeder queue, and a vulture with a rosette and a megaphone riding on top of an old tour bus. The blue swan arch at the far left leads back to the forest.

doors.label: La forêt · The forest
doors.hint: Walk back under the swan arch to the forest

insectes.name: Les insectes · The insects
insectes.alt: A flowery meadow full of insects. Left half: a fly landing on a cross-eyed moose's nose, a flea in a puce jacket hopping onto a computer chip, an ant carrying a cookie crumb, a bee carrying honey pots over yellow flowers, and an old tree stump with tiny things to look at closer. Right half: a snail carrying a cargo of parcels, a little red beetle racing round daisies in a scarf, an insect orchestra with a grasshopper violinist and a beetle drummer, a butterfly on a papillon dog's ear, a nurse combing a louse out with a giant comb, a ladybird riding a swing like a pendulum, a worm waving from an apple, a mosquito with a moustache near a man asleep in a hammock, and a scarab beetle pushing a ball of mud. The flower arch at the top left leads back to the glade.

doors.label: La forêt · The forest
doors.hint: Walk back under the flower arch to the forest

zooms.label: la souche · the stump
zooms.hint: Look closer at the old tree stump

soucheinsectes.name: La souche des insectes · The insects' stump
soucheinsectes.alt: Close-up of the old tree stump in the meadow, all on the left: picnickers gaping, frozen, at a wasp, ants waiting politely in the anteroom of a beehive, a girl strumming a guitar to a singing cicada, a ladybird's day of twists and turns with a raindrop, a gust of wind and a frog, a beetroot in a party hat dancing, and a bed under a mosquito net with mosquitoes bumping against it.
